risk_note: RV2 (linking/**; order attribution: relation_conflict is never recoverable). 30151 conflict log (app.union_binding_conflicts, migration 0025): Taobao bindings write one row per 30151 by kind (occupied / cooling / rebind) in the binding transaction, including the loser of a concurrent unique violation; a row written while the user already has an active binding is resolved at once (already_active). Every path that makes a binding active (Taobao bindings new / invalid -> active / cooled released restored; PDD authority query insert / set active) resolves all unresolved rows of that user and platform in the same transaction (bound_active). Writes and resolves are serialized by one pg_advisory_xact_lock per (app, user, platform) (Codex money r1 S1). Open with no_rebate on the no-rebate path reads the current requester's unresolved rows -> link_logs.no_rebate_reason = relation_conflict before binding_blocked; the BR-ID-24 site-authorization exception comes first; someone else's share link ignores no_rebate; only the log row is overridden, not the idempotent request body. Refusal logs (50301 before binding_blocked) now also carry the server reason (B1-06v follow-up). Written by hand.
